process.title: From order to live site in four steps
process.description: Choose a plan, add a domain and your site is online the same day.

discovery.title: Choose a plan
discovery.description: Compare shared, VPS and dedicated plans and pick the resources that fit your site.

design.title: Pick a domain
design.description: Register a new domain or point an existing one to your hosting account.

development.title: Set up your site
development.description: Install a CMS in one click, upload your files or let us migrate your site for free.

launch.title: Go live and stay supported
launch.description: Your site is online with SSL and backups, and our team is on hand around the clock.
